title: Maharashtra in Monsoon
subtitle: Rain-soaked Pune, green cliffs and cave temples, forest paths through Matheran, and the streets and sea of Mumbai.

chapters.title: Lakeside roads and open views
paragraphs: High water reaches the trees beside the road. Further on, the valley opens out beneath shifting clouds and patches of sunlight.

chapters.title: Green tracks and a waterfall stop
paragraphs: A waterfall descends the rocky hillside. Red earth tracks cross fields that turn vivid green beneath the dark ridgeline.

photos.caption: A traveller standing below white water flowing down a broad rocky hillside.

paragraphs: Smooth boulders divide the river into pools and narrow passages. The path back leads through dense woods to an open meadow.

photos.caption: Water and large smooth boulders beneath trees, with visitors further upstream.

paragraphs: Waterfalls thread through the forest and down broad rock faces beside the road. Spray gathers among the stones at their feet.

paragraphs: Bright grass covers the plateau beneath layered ridges. At the lookout, sheer cliffs fall into a deep forested gorge under low cloud.

chapters.title: A rainbow on the return road
paragraphs: A full rainbow appears above the road. Golden light slips beneath the clouds before the dam and reservoir fade into blue evening light.

paragraphs: A waterfall descends the green hillside on the approach to Matheran.

photos.caption: A waterfall descending several rocky ledges between vivid green hillside plants.

paragraphs: Narrow tracks wind through dense trees. The little train links rain-darkened platforms and small station buildings.

paragraphs: Dogs wait by the station shops and horses wear bright yellow rain covers. Beyond the stone arch, umbrellas move along the red-paved market lane.
